title: AgentChain
description: v2 (2026-07-29): the EFFECTIVE chain for one (agent, model) pair — this backend's source order (agent-supply → sources.order) filtered by 'this source can supply this model, mapping applied' (spec §4.3 step 2, §4.6). Closes v1's honesty gap: v1 showed one order per agent while N different chains ran underneath it, one per model. Read-only projection, computed per request, never persisted.

model_id.description: The model as the caller asked for it — the built-in id for fixed-menu backends, the prefixed identifier for open menus. Mapping is applied inside; the caller does not pre-resolve it.

chain.description: Ordered, position 0 = tried first. Rendered with the same order-chip visuals as the agent row (frame V6 01). An EMPTY array is a first-class answer, not an error: the model is in the menu but no source in this backend's order can supply it, so the UI flags 无来源可供 (spec §4.6) rather than letting a checkbox silently fail.

via_mapping.description: true when this source supplies the model only because a per-agent mapping rewrote the requested id (spec §4.3 step 1). UI marks the chip 经映射.

status.description: Mirrors the source's global state (source.schema.json → state.status) so the chip can dim / gold-dot / flag without a second round trip. Source-global by design: health belongs to the account, not to the agent.

resolved_model_id.description: The id actually sent upstream when via_mapping is true (e.g. glm-5.2 for a requested claude-opus-4-6); null when it equals model_id.
